verdict: Instagram ads are paying back roughly $5 for every $1 spent heading into Thanksgiving week.
diagnosis: $7,159 in Instagram spend drove 693 purchases and $36,875 in revenue this period — strong returns, but checkout drop-off is the next lever.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 5.1x
signals.detail: $36,875 revenue on $7,159 spend. Well above the 2.7x median for food and beverage brands on Meta.

signals.headline: 789 add-to-carts, only 297 checkouts
signals.detail: Roughly 6 in 10 shoppers abandon between cart and checkout. A clear recovery opportunity before Thanksgiving.

signals.headline: Cost per purchase around $10
signals.detail: 693 purchases at $7,159 spend is efficient for a premium meat box. Room to scale spend before returns compress.

signals.headline: Reach of 370,706 this period
signals.detail: Frequency at 1.37 means most people saw the ad once. Audience is not fatigued yet.

signals.headline: 97 new reviews landed this period
signals.detail: Google review velocity is strong and supports local trust signals right before the holiday rush.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage converts higher than most categories
benchmark.body: Food and beverage ecommerce typically converts at 4.9–6.2%, roughly double the DTC average. Median Meta return on ad spend sits near 2.7x. Billy Doe's 5.1x is well above category norms.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Fresh turkey orders peak the Tuesday before Thanksgiving. Alternative mains like duck, ham and lamb see sharp lift as families skip traditional birds. The current Reels caption is aligned with this shift.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Butchers and BBQ shops selling holiday bundles
competitor.body: Regional butchers and barbecue brands are pushing pre-order holiday packages — whole smoked turkeys, half-turkey kits and multi-meat platters priced $175–$299 — competing directly for the premium holiday table spend.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop before Thanksgiving week
recommendations.detail: 297 checkouts from 789 add-to-carts means 62% abandon. Consider a cart reminder email, guest checkout, and a visible holiday delivery cutoff date.

recommendations.title: Push more budget into the winning Premium Box ad
recommendations.detail: At 5.1x return and 1.37 frequency, the audience is not saturated. Worth testing a 25–40% budget lift through the Tuesday before Thanksgiving.

recommendations.title: Launch a retargeting ad for alternative holiday mains
recommendations.detail: The duck, Cornish hen and lamb angle in the current Reel is on-trend. Test a retargeting set aimed at the 789 cart adders who did not buy.
